user.title: Domotec NUOS via Modbus TCP gateway
user.description: Read-only. The connection test reads one holding register (address 8). Nothing is ever written.

data_description.unit_id: Unit (slave) id of the NUOS on the gateway's serial port. Never the id of another device on the same gateway.
data_description.model: NUOS 400 B (VTC200) has no published register map; candidate entities stay disabled until validated.

error.cannot_connect: No Modbus answer from the unit.
error.endpoint_in_use: This gateway endpoint is already in use by another integration with different link settings.

abort.already_configured: This gateway endpoint and unit are already configured.

data_description.datapoint_register_space: Unvalidated. The manual lists FC03 and FC04 without saying which table uses which. Input (FC04) is the inferred default.
data_description.address_offset: Unvalidated. 0 assumes the manual's 'Modbus Adresse' is the PDU address. Does not affect the fixed holding register 8 diagnostic.
